title: RPM CD19-mbIL15-CAR-T Cells in Patient With Advanced Lymphoid Malignancies
brief_summary: This is an open-label Phase 1 study to determine the feasibility, safety, and the recommended maximum tolerated Dose (MTD) of a single infusion of RPM CD19 mbIL15 CAR-T cells for adult patients. Approximately 24 subjects will be enrolled and it is anticipated approximately 16 subjects will be infused at the varied doses of T cells.
condition: Primary Mediastinal Large B Cell Lymphoma
